name: IBISWorld
description: Turn Claude into your personal industry analyst, powered by IBISWorld's coverage of thousands of industries and 10 million data points. Access revenue and employment statistics, financial ratios, risk scores, cost structures, trade data, analyst-written insights, and other industry statistics. Size markets, forecast trends, and assess risk across banking, consulting, accounting, sales, and other strategic workflows without ever leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add IBISWorld to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IBISWorld to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ibisworld.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IBISWorld MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IBISWorld provides these MCP tools: fetch_metadata, fetch_chapters, search_company, search_industry, search_industry_region, search_procurement, search_business_environment, and search_segment_benchmark.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IBISWorld?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IBISWorld in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
IBISWorld requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
IBISWorld is developed by IBISWorld. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
